question: What power did the Trailokya-vijaya armor demonstrate when worn by Madhusūdana?
premises: After wearing it, he killed all demons.
The armor is the instrument enabling this feat.
inference: Wearing the Trailokya-vijaya armor empowered Madhusūdana to destroy all demons.
plain_english: Having worn this armor, Madhusūdana killed all the demons.
